NAV NOISE

Repairing the west window

The west window needed a new seal after water reached the inner frame. We measured the opening, checked the drainage holes and removed the loose strip before fitting a replacement. These notes describe the order of work and the checks used to confirm the repair.

The replacement seal follows the window manual. After fitting it, we closed the latch several times and checked the corners for gaps. A gentle water test showed whether the drainage path remained open, and the results were recorded for the next visit.
